demandReviews.queueDesc: Architecture, security, and data-governance tasks opened when a submitted demand flags impact. Validation stays blocked until each triggered review is endorsed without a critical finding.
demandReviews.emptyQueueHint: Submit a demand with architecture, security, or data impact to open reviewer tasks.
demandReviews.queueCount: {count, plural, one {# review awaiting endorsement} other {# reviews awaiting endorsement}}
demandReviews.reviewDesc: Endorse or return the locked business case. Critical findings keep commercial validation blocked (BR-015).
demandReviews.roleBanner: This review is assigned to {role}. You are signed in as {current}. Switch persona to decide.
demandReviews.assessmentPlaceholder: Record fit, reuse, standards, controls, or data-ownership findings (minimum 20 characters to endorse)…
demandReviews.criticalHint: Keeps the demand in PI-05 until the finding is resolved. Records an approved-with-conditions decision.
demandReviews.returnHint: Returning unlocks the demand and withdraws sibling pending reviews. The business owner must revise and resubmit.
demandReviews.endorseSuccess: Review endorsed. Remaining triggered reviews still block validation.
demandReviews.endorseAllClear: All triggered reviews are clear. Demand is ready for commercial validation (PI-06).
demandReviews.endorseCritical: Endorsed with a critical finding. Commercial validation remains blocked.
demandReviews.returnSuccess: Demand returned for revision. The business owner can edit again.
demandReviews.policyHint: BR-015 — applicable architecture, security/privacy, and data-governance reviews must pass before validation.

consolidation.title: Consolidation Decision Pack
consolidation.desc: Complete the funding recommendation and attach decision items, risks, and proposed conditions before submitting to the CTO Budget Gate (G-B1).
consolidation.lockedByApproval: This pack is locked — the budget has been approved at Gate G-B1.
consolidation.summaryPlaceholder: Provide the Commercial & Budgeting team's consolidated recommendation, covering funding rationale, prioritisation, and any ceiling adjustments (min. 20 characters)…
consolidation.con018Hint: Required before budget submission to G-B1 (BR-027). This narrative appears in the CTO decision pack.
consolidation.con019Hint: Add exception items that require individual CTO attention — cost escalations, scope expansions, deferred items, etc.
consolidation.con020Hint: Document budget-level risks that span multiple demands or relate to funding availability.
consolidation.con021Hint: List any conditions the CTO should attach to approval — milestones, reviews, reporting requirements.
consolidation.saveHint: Save is required before the budget can be submitted to Gate G-B1.
consolidation.saveSuccess: Consolidation pack saved. You can now submit the budget to G-B1.

demandValidation.queueDesc: Commercial & Budgeting review of submitted demands. Validated demands can enter budget consolidation (BR-021). Duplicate conflicts must be dispositioned before a decision can be recorded (BR-020).
demandValidation.emptyQueueHint: Demands reach this queue once submitted (no impact flags) or after all conditional reviews are endorsed.
demandValidation.queueCount: {count, plural, one {# demand awaiting validation} other {# demands awaiting validation}}
demandValidation.workspaceDesc: Review the demand for financial completeness, scope clarity, and commercial viability. A validated decision allows the demand to be linked to budget lines.
demandValidation.duplicateAlertDesc: One or more active demands with similar titles exist. Provide a written disposition and reference the related demand IDs before submitting a validation decision.
demandValidation.br020DispositionPlaceholder: Explain why this demand is unique, or why the overlap is acceptable…
demandValidation.br020Hint: BR-020: Duplicate check non-clear status blocks validation until you accept the overlap here.
demandValidation.commentsOptionalPlaceholder: Optional — add any remarks for Validated decisions…
demandValidation.commentsRequiredPlaceholder: Required — explain conditions, reasons for return, or non-fundable rationale (min. 10 characters)…
demandValidation.successValidated: Demand validated. It is now eligible to be linked to budget lines.
demandValidation.successValidatedCond: Demand validated with conditions. Budget team should note the attached conditions.
demandValidation.successReturned: Demand returned for revision. The business owner can edit and resubmit.
demandValidation.successNotFundable: Demand marked Not Fundable and closed from the pipeline.
